Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)

A complex skeletal locking and reinforcement system, intended to provide professional racecar drivers a superior chance of survival in severe accidents. Turns out it’s also great at stopping bullets.

External Body Cyberware. Requires Skinweave or Subdermal Armor. Whenever the user sacrifices their Move Action, for any reason, they can activate this cyberware without an Action. Until the start of their next Turn, their SP is considered to be 2 higher. This SP cannot be ablated, but can be halved by any usual sources of halving armor. Once activated, this cyberware has a 1 hour cooldown before it can be activated again. Only one Scarab may be installed at a time.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
